bayts.text: He is absent from every created being for the Creator, possessed of an immense light and a secret drawn from the mysteries.
He erases from the heart the rust that at times defiles it, as the washer erases impurities from a garment.
Those are people whose companion in assembly is never wretched, for they bring the disciples felicities.
Blessed is the servant, a sincere disciple toward them, through service, through love or through gifts!
They attained ranks by following in the footsteps of the Messenger, the Chosen One (Muḥammad): may He bless him Who grants distinctions.
They attained, by following what the Trustworthy One (Muḥammad) brought – upon him, from me, my blessing at every hour –
merits which neither pen nor tongue can contain, in writing or in narratives.
Among them deep learning in the science of the Sharīʿa, with the science of the Ḥaqīqa, before ascetic disciplines,
for ascetic exercise and spiritual direction, before these two (sciences), are among what draws delusion together with miseries.
Among them refraining from speech and from action until they see it sound through the testimonies.
Among them persistence in the fear of Allah, their Master, in the state of beginnings as in the state of endings,
for in the beginnings fear of sin restrains them, and in the endings the reverence of the Majesties.
Among them persistence in humbling the soul, without ostentation, since it is possessed of cunning and treacheries.
They always regard themselves as beneath all creatures, and (hold) that they are not worthy of charisms,
and that they are the most sinful of all sinners, and are not worthy of answered prayers.
Among them persistence in patience, for God's sake, before the injustice of all the disobedient and before misfortunes.
Whenever harm befell them from those around them, they turned in repentance to Allah for the multitude of sins.
And among their merits – may the good pleasure of their Lord be upon them for ever – is sorrow at every hour.
And among their natures is manifest the fear of hypocrisy, the fear of disgrace in the terror of the Resurrection.
Among them humility before the Subduer (Al-Qahhār), their Master, truthfulness and renunciation, with purification from the (soul's) blights.
Among them taking refuge with the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) for ever, to draw (good) and repel (evil), laying their complaints before Him.
Knowledge is their hallmark, forbearance their custom, without pretensions and without denial of the (spiritual) stations.
Alas for the loss of masters whose way is the way of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), the best of creatures!
May He bless him, with the greeting of peace, Who sent him, together with the Family and the Companions, those who have won the Gardens.
May He bless him, with the greeting of peace, Who raised him up, with the purest blessing, through which we are shielded from delusions.
May his Creator bless him, with the greeting of peace, together with the Family and the Companions, those who have gained the gifts.
May his Master bless him, with the greeting of peace, with the purest blessing, through which we gain (spiritual) openings.
May his Provider bless him, with the greeting of peace, together with the Family and the Companions, those who submitted through acts of obedience.
May He Who honours him bless him, with the greeting of peace, with the purest blessing, through which we gain charisms.
May He Who made him master bless him, with the greeting of peace, together with the Family and the Companions, those who have received (divine) care.
May He Who ennobled him bless him, with the greeting of peace, with the purest blessing, through which we gain unveilings.
May He bless him and grant him peace Who openly set him before (all), together with the Family, as many times as the number of creatures.
May He Who exalted him bless him, with the greeting of peace, with the purest blessing, through which we gain elevations.
Alas for the loss of my masters who have passed on, with what they took with them of wondrous treasures!
Upon him who is set foremost in the two Abodes, their model, the blessing of the Well-Pleased Who called them to the meetings.
Upon the Beloved, son of ʿAbd Allāh, our master, the blessing of the All-Sufficient (Al-Kāfī) Who has spared them every anguish.
Upon him whose intercession shall be accepted on the Day of Gathering for the noble, the blessing of the Healer (Ash-Shāfī) Who healed them of snares.
Upon him whose excellence never ends, the blessing of the Guide (Al-Hādī) Who guided them to uprightness.
Upon the Honoured One, the best of all creation, the blessing of the Enricher (Al-Mughnī) Who rewarded them with the best of goods.
Upon him be the most lasting blessing together with peace, and upon all his illustrious Family, at all times.
Upon the Companions and all the masters, the good pleasure of the Lord of the earths and the heavens.
